headlines.text: On this day in 2024, Swerve Strickland vs. Konosuke Takeshita met in a Number One Contender, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 8.24 ? a fantastic contest. In a match that determined Samoa Joe's next World Title challenger, Strickland outlasted a hard-hitting Takeshita with his newly rechristened finisher, Big Pressure, punching his ticket to Dynasty.
